Package com.github.crittscott.somestacks.util

Class StackItemStorage

java.lang.Object
com.github.crittscott.somestacks.util.StackItemStorage
public class StackItemStorage extends Object
Fixed-size block-local storage with simulated insertion/extraction and NBT persistence. Automation addresses complete runs through the loader adapters, rather than exposing this inventory.

Unreadable, out-of-range, or duplicate-slot item tags are retained verbatim under SetAside, saved with the block, and retried on each load. Loading and direct assignment bypass admission so stored items remain recoverable after policy changes.

Subclasses supply slot limits, admission, and content-change notifications.

    • getSlots

    • getStackInSlot

      @Nonnull public net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack getStackInSlot(int slot)
      Returns the stored stack itself, without copying it. Callers must not mutate this reference to bypass notifications; use storage mutations or setStackInSlot(int, ItemStack).

    • setStackInSlot

      public void setStackInSlot(int slot, @Nonnull net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack stack)
      Stores the supplied stack reference without copying or checking admission or stack limits, then calls onContentsChanged(int). The caller transfers ownership and must not mutate the stack afterward. Slot indices must be within this inventory's fixed capacity.

    • insertItem

      @Nonnull public net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack insertItem(int slot, @Nonnull net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack stack, boolean simulate)
      Inserts into one slot and returns the unaccepted remainder without mutating the offer. Simulation computes the remainder without changing contents.

      A full insertion into an empty slot can retain the supplied stack reference. Callers must relinquish an accepted offer or supply a copy before further mutation. Successful committed insertions notify onContentsChanged(int); simulations do not.

    • extractItem

      @Nonnull public net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack extractItem(int slot, int amount, boolean simulate)
      Removes up to the requested amount from one slot; simulation leaves contents unchanged.

    • serializeNBT

      public net.minecraft.nbt.CompoundTag serializeNBT()
      Creates an NBT snapshot containing nonempty Items entries with local slot indices and any set-aside tags. Does not mutate the inventory or call change notifications.

    • deserializeNBT

      public StackItemStorage.LoadResult deserializeNBT(net.minecraft.nbt.CompoundTag nbt)
      Loads slot contents from NBT, setting aside every item tag that cannot be placed. Ordinary entries take precedence over retries; loading bypasses admission and does not call onContentsChanged(int). The caller reports returned retention counts once it knows the world location, and refreshes derived fill, shapes, and run caches.
